rules.name: Daemonic Assault
rules.description: No model is ever placed on the table during deployment. Instead all units start the game in reserve even if the mission does not allow it normally. At the beginning of your first turn divide your army into two groups that must include, as close as possible, an equal number of units. Pick one of these groups and roll 1d6. 3-6 your choice stands. 1-2 the other group is chosen instead. The group must then all enter using deep strike. The remaining units stay in reserve and roll as normal to enter

rules.name: The Tally of Pestilence
rules.description:
Whilst Epidemius is alive, keep a count of all models killed by followers of Nurgle (friend or foe, demon or model with the Mark of Nurgle). At the start of each of your turns, consult the table below to determine the effect of the Tally of Pestilence. All followers of Nurgle on the table (friend and foe) recieve the bonus characteristic or special rule shown below. All effects from the Tally of Pestilence are cumulative.

Wounds / Effect
0-4 No effect
5-9  Plagueswords now wound on +
10-14 All followers have Noxious Touch (2+ poison in melee)
15-19 All feel no pain saves are 3+ now
20+ All attacks made by a follower ignore armor saves

rules.name: Spell Syphon
rules.description: Each time an enemy Psyker successfully manifests a psychic power, place a syphon token next to the Blue Scribes. At the start of each of your turns, roll a D6 for each syphon token next to the Blue Scribes; for each 6 rolled, one friendly psyker within 12" of the Blue Scribes immediately gains a Warp Charge point. Then remove all syphon tokens from the board.

rules.name: Glamour of Tzeentch
rules.description: In the enemy shooting phase choose one enemy unit within 24" of the Changeling when that unit is chosen to fire. The target unit must either choose to not fire this shooting phase or try to see through the Glamour. If it wants to see through the Glamour it test LD (Vehicles test at LD 10) if the test is passed fire as normal. If the test is failed the unit must faire all weapons against a friendly unit chosen by the Changeling among any enemies h can see. If the Changeling can see no other units then the attack is simply cancelled instead.
